clips.title: The story
paras: Guard Thomas is a dedicated soldier of the Stormwind Army stationed at the bridge west of the Eastvale Logging Camp. Isolated on the eastern frontier of Elwynn Forest, he oversees the defense of local settlers against predatory wildlife and encroaching murlocs.

While much of the realm's attention is focused inward toward the capital or west toward Westfall, Guard Thomas holds one of the quietest yet most precarious posts in Elwynn Forest. Positioned at the stone bridge crossing the river toward Eastvale Logging Camp, Thomas acts as the thin blue line between everyday forestry workers and the aggressive creatures roaming the woods. With the Stormwind military stretched thin, guards like Thomas must rely heavily on passing adventurers to maintain order and carry messages back to central command.
